title: Planet Uranus (Indra)
sub: Complete notes on Jyotish Vidya Ep. 17 by Brajesh Gautam, The Anchor Of Life. Uranus as Indra, the navel portal, Uranus by sign, stones, threads, transits and Q&A.
desc: Complete notes on Jyotish Vidya Ep. 17, Planet Uranus (Indra) by Brajesh Gautam: the navel portal, Uranus in each sign, remedies, stones and Q&A, with video timestamps.
points: Indra is a king, not a god.
The king of heaven who dies. Good karma short of liberation. Protects your heaven and enjoys it.
Signs 1 and 8 share it. Strong navel means no fear, good digestion, good breath, good sleep.
Do not call life hell and do not talk double. Say great, no problem.
The speaker says awareness keeps Rahu and Ketu in your pocket. His health and alcohol remarks are his own.
7 years per sign, 84 years in all.
Long effects. The Moon gives 2.5 days, the Sun a month.
From a wish tree in sign 3 to a storm in sign 7.
Stones, threads, halwa as prasad and a tidy home. Not endorsed.
